Only the decision to convert to a trans-femoral approach is stated; the later sentences describe JL4 and JR4 catheter cannulation but do not restate that femoral access was performed.
It is unclear whether "recurrent" applies to bronchiectasis as well as to sinusitis in "no recurrent sinusitis or bronchiectasis".
A right sided ECG is mentioned only in a hypothetical clause about a missed diagnosis; no right sided ECG is documented as performed.

The vital signs list opens with "His blood pressure at presentation was"; "at presentation" is applied to each listed item (heart rate, afebrile, SaO2 and pain score) although it is attached in the sentence to the blood pressure.
The arrival sentence opens a new paragraph after the transfer to the cardiology centre; it names neither the destination nor what "3 hours later" is measured from.
